high_level_description: This image captures a serene evening scene with a dramatic sky as the focal point. The sky is a mix of deep blue and soft hues of orange and yellow, suggesting that it is either sunrise or sunset. There are large, dark clouds dominating the lower part of the sky, which are illuminated by the warm light from the sun, creating a striking contrast. In the foreground, there are several buildings. On the left side, there is a white building with a balcony and a few windows, which appears to be a colonial-style structure.
